_note: "The deduction in respect of amounts referred to in sub-section (2)(a) or (2)(b), which are paid on account of preventive health check-up, shall be allowed up to ₹ 5000 in aggregate" (s.126(3), p.161). Applied before the two buckets, the allowed amount split between them in the ratio claimed — DR 06 G2.3's reading (INFERENCE; the section does not say how the ₹5000 is allocated). Cash is allowed for a check-up (s.126(9)(a)). Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 counterpart, s.80D, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d2). D-136. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(2A) (thc p.341): "Where the amounts referred to in clauses (a) and (b) of sub-section (2) are paid on account of preventive health check-up, the deduction for such amounts shall be allowed to the extent it does not exceed in the aggregate five thousand rupees"; (2B) "(i) any mode, including cash" for a check-up, "(ii) any mode other than cash" otherwise. The same row. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B12. D-145.
